paper.title_en: Advancing Fundamental Physics and Cosmology with high-resolution X-ray imaging
paper.abstract_en: Black Holes are the key to solving many unanswered questions in fundamental physics: in particular, the very extreme properties shown by supermassive black holes at the centers of galaxies make them obvious candidates for testing gravity theories in the strong-field regime. Since X-rays are generated by matter under extreme physical conditions, ultra-high resolution X-ray imaging (uXRI) will directly image the region near the event horizon of black holes in X-rays, similar to the Event Horizon Telescope in the radio band, enabling unprecedented tests of General Relativity and alternative theories of gravity near supermassive black holes. On the other hand, clusters of galaxies hold the potential of unveiling many unknowns in cosmology. uXRI will unlock this potential by probing small-scale plasma properties in the intracluster medium, providing the missing link required to establish galaxy clusters as reliable tools for high-precision cosmology. Moreover, uXRI will enable mapping of Dark Matter from galaxy cluster dynamics via proper motion measurements. Finally, uXRI will open a new field of precision X-ray astrometry, allowing for measuring pulsar parallaxes to support nanoHertz gravitational wave searches.

decision.reject_reason_zh: 该论文主要讨论X射线成像技术及其在黑洞和宇宙学上的应用，对纳赫兹引力波仅简要提及，与核心主题（PTA）关联度低。
decision.title_zh: 利用高分辨率X射线成像推进基础物理与宇宙学研究
decision.abstract_zh: 黑洞是解答基础物理中许多未解问题的关键：特别是，星系中心的超大质量黑洞所展现的极端性质，使其成为在强场区域测试引力理论的明显候选者。由于X射线是由处于极端物理条件下的物质产生的，超高分辨率X射线成像（uXRI）将直接在X射线波段对黑洞事件视界附近的区域进行成像，类似于射电波段的视界望远镜，从而实现对超大质量黑洞附近广义相对论和其他替代引力理论的空前测试。另一方面，星系团有潜力揭示宇宙学中的许多未知。uXRI将通过探测星系团内介质中的小尺度等离子体性质来释放这一潜力，为建立星系团作为高精度宇宙学可靠工具提供缺失的环节。此外，uXRI将通过自行测量实现从星系团动力学绘制暗物质图。最后，uXRI将开辟精确X射线天体测量学的新领域，使得测量脉冲星视差成为可能，以支持纳赫兹引力波搜索。
